newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: NZ 77-day T-bills yield 6.754 pct at tender.
newsitem.headline: NZ 77-day T-bills yield 6.754 pct at tender.

text.p: The weighted average yield for NZ$75 million of 77-day treasury bills at Tuesday's tender was 6.754 percent versus 6.721 percent for a similar maturity at last week's tender, the Reserve Bank said.
The weighted average yield for NZ$75 million of 168-day treasury bills was 6.765 percent versus 6.733 percent for a similar maturity at last week's tender.
The weighted average yield for the NZ$50 million of 357-day treasury bills was 6.890 percent versus 6.874 percent for a similar maturity at last week's tender.
